steps.name: What it covers
steps.meaning: The parts that have a curve, their share of the value, and what has none yet
steps.fact: 2 parts with a curve · 4 without one yet
paragraphs: Wildfire on wind farms: cell-local judgment-based screening points per FSim flame-length class, adopted under owner direction; research supports the mechanism and relative ordering, not the numbers. It names 2 parts: Pad electrical and GSU protection, control and DC. Outside its scope: internal turbine or electrical fire, lightning and maintenance fires, business interruption, revenue, PSPS and shutdown, post-fire erosion, flood and landslide and soft, sunk and non-physical costs. Kinds of damage it does not include: firebrand attack and destructive residue or soot (separate deferred pathways) and mitigation or clearance credit and operating state (captured, no numeric effect).

For this hazard the wind farm is split into 2 parts: Pad electrical and GSU protection, control and DC. 10 further units are named but withheld — wt turbine fire assembly, wt collection network, wt gsu main transformer, wt gsu switchgear bus, wt gsu cable terminations, wt control met om, wt foundation, wt civil infra, support fieldwork and support transport logistics — a stated 'not zero', not a curve. Parts of the plant's value with no curve yet: turbine fire assembly: blades, nacelle, tower (withheld, not zero), collection network, GSU main transformer, GSU switchgear and bus, GSU cable terminations (withheld), control, met-station and O&M buildings; foundation; civil (withheld) and fieldwork and transport support (allocated once after repair scope; no fragility).

The damage ratio is a share of direct replacement value of the same named unit (one pad's electrical equipment, or the one shared GSU protection-control-DC package). The files state no plant-level dollar figure for this asset.
